content.short: Cexplorer.io is a fast Cardano blockchain explorer from the adapools team with a modern user experience.
content.description: Cexplorer.io is presented as the successor to earlier explorer work from the adapools team. The project focuses on delivering a fast, feature-rich Cardano blockchain explorer with a more modern interface, while also supporting separate mainnet and testnet views. Its role is similar to other explorers in the ecosystem, but the product positioning emphasizes speed, breadth, and a cleaner user experience.
content.meta: Presented as the successor to earlier explorer work from the adapools team. Explore cexplorer.io on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
